build_escnmd_backbone: build an eSCNMDBackbone model with configurable sphere channels, lmax, and num_layers for molecular property prediction
create_mlp_efs_head: create an MLP_EFS_Head to predict energy, forces, and stress from node embeddings using autograd derivatives
create_mlp_stress_head: create an MLP_Stress_Head to predict isotropic and anisotropic stress tensor components from node embeddings
create_linear_force_head: create a Linear_Force_Head using SO3_Linear to predict direct forces from equivariant node embeddings
review_gradregressconfig: review the GradRegressConfig dataclass to configure direct forces, stress, and hessian computation options
